hero.title: Tell me what is getting in the way.
hero.lede: You do not need a polished scope or the right technical terminology. A short note about what feels slow, confusing, outdated, manual, unreliable, or hard to own is enough to start.

helpfulDetails.title: A few details can make the first conversation more useful.
items: What you are trying to accomplish
What feels slow, confusing, manual, expensive, or unreliable
Any deadline, platform, ownership, or budget constraint that already matters

email.title: Email Eddie
email.noteTitle: Please keep ordinary email appropriate for ordinary email.
email.noteBody: Do not send passwords, MFA or recovery codes, private keys, API tokens, payment-card information, PHI, or other sensitive secrets in an initial message.

phone.title: Text or Call Eddie
phone.noteTitle: Keep texts appropriate for ordinary text messaging.
phone.noteBody: Do not send passwords, MFA or recovery codes, private keys, API tokens, payment-card information, PHI, or other sensitive secrets by text.

whatNext.title: Clarify the need before prescribing the solution.
whatNext.body: The first step is to understand the current situation, desired outcome, and important constraints. From there, the work can be scoped around the smallest practical solution rather than starting with a predetermined product or platform.

quickStart.title: A useful first message can be simple.
quickStart.body: What are you trying to improve, and what is happening today? If a deadline, platform, ownership issue, or budget constraint already matters, include it. Everything else can be worked through together.

discovery.title: Tell us what you're trying to improve.
discovery.body: If a quick text or email is not enough, use the short guided project form. You do not need to know which service or technical solution you need.
discovery.label: Open guided project form
discovery.privacyText: Information you submit is used to review and respond to your request and to administer a potential business relationship.
discovery.safetyText: Do not submit passwords, MFA or recovery codes, API keys, private keys, payment-card information, protected health information (PHI), CUI or other government-restricted information, or confidential customer/client records.
discovery.expectationText: Submitting the form is an initial discovery request, not a quote, contract, or commitment to perform work.
